name: aasb-aas-security-engineer
description: Install the "AAS Security Engineer" workflow plugin from Agentic Awesome Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Run authorized security testing, audit, vulnerability validation, web testing, and hardening workflows.
interface.longDescription: Run authorized security testing, audit, vulnerability validation, web testing, and hardening workflows. Map threats and agent-skill risks, assess explicitly authorized targets, and produce reproducible findings, remediation priorities and retest steps. Recommended for: Authorized security teams, Maintainers validating reported findings, Cloud and app security reviewers. Not for: Targets without explicit authorization, Routine defensive feature implementation: use Secure App Builder. Covers Ethical Hacking Methodology, Burp Suite Testing, and 10 more skills.
defaultPrompt: Review the supplied assets, written authorization and permitted scope. Prepare a security assessment plan and report template. Before any active test, confirm the exact target, command and expected effect; record findings with evidence and retest steps.
Use this plugin to validate this vulnerability report and separate confirmed risk from false positives.
Use this plugin to review this system for web, API, cloud, and SAST coverage gaps.

Review this project for the added coverage: Map trust boundaries, threats and mitigations before active assessment; Inspect agent skill instructions and bundled files for unsafe authority or data flows. Use only the relevant skills and existing stack. Report observed checks and limitations; prepare drafts before external or production actions.
